label: Test rational exercise as formative rather than merely classified
summary: Continuation of PR-1971 and PR-1962. Note: docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md#can-the-same-intrinsic-actuality-understand-and-produce-blindly-2026-11-25. Inspected the existing agency overlay and actual theorem A (b5b84276): intellect, will bridge, rational-power bridge, owned exercise and one power yield rational power classification of actual giving. This excludes a separate non-rational exercised power conditional on those premises, not wholly blind actual governance on a thin Exercises reading. Read Aristotle Metaphysics Theta.2/5 and Aquinas ST I q.25 a.1 co./ad 3–4 and a.5 ad 1 in the linked primary translations for navigation; no registered attribution. The understood account is the distinctive formative rationale of productive art; actual exercising qua rational inclination gives direct conceptual warrant for an operative apprehended good at some scope, not determination of every effect. The actual application of this strong sense to giving is OPEN. Contrast a separate intrinsic blind constituent with a proposed one-actuality contemplative source knowing its own objective good-directed propensity; identity does not transfer relevance under intentional descriptions, and explanatory aspect distinction alone does not establish real constituents. Actual governance of the productive exercise and residual selection among permitted realizations have different explanatory scopes. A rival supplying only the latter given a genuinely directed giving is not a replacement for the former. Neither case is a strict-simple metaphysical model. Own-good love, recipient-directed good, full existential PSR, and same-source/holder bridges retain their independent obligations. No frozen dictionary or proof change, new formal consequence or attributed claim. The earlier qualified review is preserved in assessment_history. Follow-up on base 30a9820018644fe98d92b9f10874c3382340a9ee: docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md#does-practical-inactivity-divide-the-source-2026-11-25 reads ST I q.79 a.10 ad 3/a.11 and q.77 a.3 as a finite-power control: differing practical roles need not distinguish powers under the stated formal-object criterion. This is not a strict-simple-source model. The q.3 a.6–7 actualizer/receiver and real-constituent criteria discriminate a genuinely decomposed account, not a distinction of explanatory aspects; q.25 a.1 requires symmetric treatment of the personal account. Adding nonreceptive knowledge of the actual giving does not by itself identify the known content as its practical measure. Invariant knowledge of a fixed contingent truth plus factivity creates the same necessity pressure on either account; relational self-knowledge does not by itself establish reverse grounding or formative governance. Temporal immutability remains distinct from modal intrinsic invariance; the existing same-token collapse bundle is reused without alteration. Primary translations were read for research; no existing q.77/q.79 passage witness was found in the bounded locator/path search, so no materialization or pinned attribution is claimed. Advisory novelty retrieval identified the substantial prior treatments. No new formal consequence, graph edge or premise discharge; this extension is independently reviewed with qualifications and published in draft PR-1962; the current assessment records the exact review and verification boundaries. Further simplicity/forms test: docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md#one-simple-productive-nature-and-many-forms-2026-11-25 examines De potentia q.7 a.1 ad 1, 7–8 and q.3 a.16 co., ad 11, 13–15. A unitary productive nature can be proposed as the ground of a differentiated whole without receiving each effect form; the actual constitution, not numerical labels, is at issue. A whole’s many parts, admissible alternative orders and its actual production remain separate. The strongest rival is an articulated primitive with the same explanatory stopping permission, not a certified strict-simple model. Actual natural-necessity premises cannot silently replace the granted nonnecessitation. Primary readings and advisory reuse are recorded in the note; no new pinned claim, Lean declaration or support edge.
blocker: OPEN, simplicity/forms and actual governance: Establish a real intrinsic constitutive dependency in the proposed whole-order noncognitive efficacy, or establish that the actual productive principle is apprehended content in formative exercise. Apply the same composition criterion to the personal and contemplative accounts. A natural-agency premise fixing one total order must be defended against the expressly granted nonnecessitating rival, not installed through the word impersonal. Repeating one-power labels, counting forms or supplying a context-dependent finite example does not establish the required ultimate constitution.

current_assessment.assessment: De potentia q.7 a.1 explicitly distinguishes one power/operation from multiple effects and distinguishes virtual natural efficacy from many understood objects. The source combines these in an intellectual account; it does not endorse the noncognitive candidate. Nevertheless the composition objection needs actual receiver/actualizer or constituent relations, not a count of effect forms. The strengthened impersonal proposal makes one integrated whole its per se product and originates its differentiating conditions. Its strict-simple realization remains open. Multiple parts, alternative total orders and actual exercise do not entail one another. OnePower is an at-most-one constraint; the full A/B bundles classify owned rational exercise without content-indexed practical governance. The prior actual-governance underdetermination remains.

assessment_history.scope: Practical-role plurality and formative use at the same intellectual source
assessment_history.assessment: The finite-power source account challenges a generic inference from practical-role difference to distinct powers; it does not model the strict-simple rival. Actualizer/receiver or genuinely distinct constituent relations could exclude a decomposed rival, but have not been established for the one-actuality contemplative proposal. Adding actual nonreceptive self-knowledge does not by itself establish formative use. The earlier underdetermination of actual governance is retained, with equal credit for matched actual supply and output.
assessment_history.next_test: The generic inference from distinct practical roles to distinct powers lacks the required formal-object qualification; even a source with one actual intellectual power need not satisfy a content-indexed governance claim by identity alone. Establish a same-source productive determination received as a genuinely distinct actualizer, or distinct intrinsic constituents, if using composition against the contemplative rival. Alternatively establish that the actual existential giving exercises the intellectual inclination in its formative mode. Actual self-knowledge of the giving does not supply that application without explaining why its content is the productive measure. A defended unitary contemplative account with actual supply and content would strengthen the rival; a demonstrated received productive determination would weaken it under strict simplicity. Preserve the same n, x and causal respect, apply the criterion symmetrically, and retain separate recipient-good and modal-scope obligations.
